name: Upgrade All Cards (全卡升级)
author: JiesiLuo
description: Start every run with a fully upgraded deck and all three egg relics (Frozen, Molten, Toxic), so every card you see is the upgraded version. Eggs are removed from the relic pool. | 每局开始时初始牌组全部升级，并自带冰冻蛋、熔岩蛋、毒蛋三个遗物，之后拿到的每张牌都是升级版；三个蛋会从遗物池中移除。
